name: Cryo
source:
A terminally-ill man volunteers for an experimental cryogenics program in order to cure himself.  Instead of a cure, fantastic worlds reveal themselves to make Hell a reality for him.

[From [url=https://gameazimuth.itch.io/cryo-visual-novel] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名身患绝症的男子自愿参加实验性低温计划以治愈自己。奇妙的世界并没有治愈他，而是显露出来，让地狱对他来说成为现实。

[来自[url=https://gameazimuth.itch.io/cryo-visual-novel] itch.io[/url]]
